Company:
Oliver Wyman
Description:
Overview
Oliver Wyman Vector is seeking an experienced Software Developer to support the development of software for complex aerospace systems. This role will work closely with systems engineers, test engineers, and other software developers to design and implement software solutions from defined software-level requirements.
The Software Developer will contribute throughout the software development lifecycle, including software design, implementation, integration, troubleshooting, and verification within a DO-178C-driven development environment.
Basic Qualifications (Required Skills/Experience)
· 5+ years of professional software development experience, with approximately 5–10 years preferred.
· Strong software development experience using Java and/or Python.
· Ability to develop software from defined software-level requirements through design and implementation.
· Experience designing, developing, debugging, and maintaining software within complex systems.
· Familiarity with RTCA DO-178C software certification and the software development processes and documentation driven by DO-178C.
· Ability to collaborate with systems engineering and test teams throughout software development, integration, and verification.
· Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
· Ability to work effectively in an environment with evolving requirements and technical ambiguity.
· Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to encourage open communication and continuous feedback.
Preferred Qualifications (Desired Skills/Experience)
· Experience developing software for aerospace, avionics, aircraft, or other safety-critical systems.
· Experience with airplane software development and certification.
· Familiarity with requirements-driven software development and traceability.
· Experience working within a structured software development lifecycle, including requirements, design, implementation, integration, verification, and delivery.
· Experience with software integration, debugging, and troubleshooting in a system or lab environment.
· Familiarity with airplane network systems, communication systems, or networked embedded systems.
· Experience working with cross-functional engineering teams, including systems engineering, software development, integration, and test.
· Familiarity with development and issue-tracking tools such as Git and Jira.
· Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, mathematics, physics, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
Knowledge, Abilities & Other Characteristics
· Full-time role supporting a combination of remote and in-office work (hybrid).
· Located in the Greater Seattle, WA area.
· Ability to work independently while contributing effectively as part of a larger engineering team.
· Customer focus and willingness to respond to changing technical and program priorities.
Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. This position is not eligible for employer-sponsored work authorization now or in the future.
The applicable base salary range for this role is $110,000 - $160,000.
Oliver Wyman is a business of Marsh (NYSE: MRSH), a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit oliverwyman.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X.
Marsh is committed to embracing a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best people and embrace diversity of age background, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, veteran status (including protected veterans), or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please let us know by contacting reasonableaccommodations@marsh.com.
Marsh is committed to hybrid work, which includes the flexibility of working remotely and the collaboration, connections and professional development benefits of working together in the office. All Marsh colleagues are expected to be in their local office or working onsite with clients at least three days per week. Office-based teams will identify at least one “anchor day” per week on which their full team will be together in person.

Overview

Our focus on unleashing the potential of our people creates an environment where top talent can thrive both professionally and personally. As we navigate complexity, integrate operations and technology, and prioritize diversity of thought, we empower our teams to exceed expectations. By fostering deep connections, building trust, and acting with integrity, we build high performing teams that drive individuals to achieve their fullest potential. Join Oliver Wyman Vector, where your skills and passion can make a lasting impact in an environment that values excellence, growth, and meaningful connections.

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience
Analytical thinker with excellent problem-solving skills.
Comfortable being 80% hands-on while maintaining architectural vision
Experience with Linux based development and platform modernization
9+ years of experience as a Software Engineer, or similar role in a technology driven environment.
5+ years of experience in software development life cycles, configuration management and best agile software engineering practices.
5+ years of experience applying or working within guidelines of RTCA DO-178C standard, Software Consideration in Airborne Systems and Equipment Certification.
Preferred Qualifications:
Systems software requirements definition & decomposition for airplane network systems, validation and verification, development assurance, safety analysis, and systems integration
Demonstrated design of software architecture, engineering standards, and migration guardrails for embedded Linux build reproducibility, patching, and lifecycle management
Work with TLS protocols, cipher suites and libraries
Working with systems engineers and test engineers to define and validate highly reliable system functionality
Perform risk management and trade study analyses
Provide analytical and problem-solving skills to accomplish optimal system design and integration
Experience with airplane networks and communication systems
Excellent verbal and written communications
Customer focus and ability to jump to the hottest “fire” and contribute to problem solutions
